caption:
Honesty brings tranquility. Falsehood leaves the heart uneasy.

The Prophet ﷺ said to leave what makes you doubt for what does not, because truth brings tranquility while falsehood sows doubt. As the day winds down, notice what keeps unsettling your heart.

Jami at-Tirmidhi 2518 · Grade: Sahih

Is there one doubtful thing you are ready to let go of this week?

#honesty #truthfulness #peaceofmind #hadithoftheday
alt_text: Al-Hasan bin 'Ali said:"I remember that the Messenger of Allah (s.a.w) said: 'Leave what makes you in doubt for what does not make you in doubt. The truth brings tranquility while falsehood sows doubt.'" Another chain reports a similar narration (Jami at-Tirmidhi 2518)
review: Approved round 1: integrity ok, narrator Al-Hasan bin Ali matches chain, grade Sahih, caption faithful
